answer_sentences.text: The provided sources do not specify any usual pre-payment penalty rate for floating-rate personal loans sanctioned in 2026; they only say that para 261(2) applies to "loans granted for business purpose" and that older personal loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 cannot be charged pre-payment charges.
answer_sentences.quote: (2) For all floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (as defined in Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (MSMED) Act, 2006), with or without co-obligant(s):

answer_sentences.text: For existing floating-rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025, the rule says a UCB "shall not charge pre-payment charges," but it does not give a percentage rate.
answer_sentences.quote: In case of existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers with or without co- obligant(s), a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.
